finalText:
**Redis died, and the service starved behind it.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07 | cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:15–02:31 | 13 reconnect tries, all refused |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` dies, `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Every read hit the store after the cache fell away. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 past the 500 cap. That backlog ate the heap.

Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` is the thing to fix. Nothing before 02:14 looks wrong.
